notes.title: April 1st Patch
notes.content:
No crazy April Fools update this time around!

I have been hard at work bringing some much needed and HIGHLY requested quality of life features!

Key Rebinding!
For those of you who prefer to play with a mouse and keyboard, you can now fully customize the controls to your preference!

If you play on a controller and would really like to change the control scheme, Steam Input is the easiest way to change it to whatever feels the most comfortable and that's what we recommend. 

Throwing 2.0
This one's a bit harder to put into words but essentially the throwing code has been redone to make it much more accessible for beginner players. You no longer have to be moving to throw and the toss should be much more consistent. 

Basketball has seen major improvements with this and the game now allows more focus on blocking and moving around with the ball rather than stressing about throwing mechanics. 

Last but not least...

BEAR TRAPS!
This is a new item you will find spawning in most modes. Don't get caught in its jaws or you will come away with a bit less stuffing than you had before! 

You can reset the trap by grabbing it and letting go again wherever you want to place it. BE CAREFUL- it bites!

As always, Big THANK YOU!
We love seeing people in game and love seeing everyone having a blast. More features and modes are coming very soon! We are excited to share details as they develop. Join the Discord for the latest updates or just to chat and ask questions!

See you in game!

notes.title: March 9th Patch
notes.content:
We've been watching, we've been listening, and we've been fixing.

We love watching your clips and reading your feedback. With that, certain bugs have definitely not gone unnoticed. We’ve been grinding away at some of the biggest issues—glitches, balance tweaks, and all the weird stuff that didn't feel right.

Here’s what we’ve patched:

Balance
-We have rebalanced every single mode to feel much less random and more rewarding for player performances. This is something we noticed causing a lot of frustration in players— causing landslides where players would continually lose money and not gain much in return. 
-Board spaces now give and take less
-Cookie Crumble cookies are now larger and grabbable

Language
-Super excited to announce Spanish and Japanese are joining our language lineup!
-Language selection is now a one time popup when you launch the game as many players never looked in the settings for the option to swap. Language setting still exists there but there is also presented to the player in a way where they don't have to look for it.

Onboarding
-In addition to the forced language selection, players will be dropped into the tutorial on their first playthrough. We noticed many players didn't even know there was a tutorial. It is still a left in the main menu if you would like to replay it. 

Bugs
-Post match camera will focus on the podiums properly for clients
-Hotphone and Jetpacks will now attach properly to players, making it easier to run and jump. 
-Walls have been added to the Race map so you can no longer see the skybox
-Bullets should be more consistent across all clients
-Guns don't shoot at dead bodies anymore
-Lots of ramps added to collisions that were making players stuck
-Censoring blocking partial words
-Players not sorting placements after losing money in the board game
-The ball should no longer be invisible for some clients
-Players can no longer return to the lobby while in the main menu, this was a soft lock
-Players can no longer return to the main menu from the main menu

Sounds
-New Gem reward sound!

Coming Soon
For us this goes without saying but more modes and items are definitely coming!
We have a long list of things we want to try out and we are super excited to share as soon as we can!
More cosmetics are also planned but they are a bit lower of a priority for us. 
We are still hard at work on getting the VS AI mode into the hands of the people so stay with us! If you would like to see the full roadmap- the discord is linked right under this message.

Thank you
Again big thanks to everyone who is giving our game a shot— you can't imagine what this means for us. 
Thank you to all of the streamers and content creators for making content and sharing the game with their friends and communities. 
And thank you for the feedback! We want Mini Bash to be the best it can be! The only way we are going to get there is with YOUR help and feedback. 

See you in game!

notes.title: March 1st Update!
notes.content:
Matchmaking

Option to set lobby to private!
Ability to see and kick unwanted players from the pause menu
The Lobby Computer now shows who is the hosting player
A message popup when the host leaves or you get kicked
Added text chat!


Additions

Exit to menu button added to pause menu
Lobby settings and game settings separated in the pause menu


Fixes

The placement sort logic is FIXED! [strike]Sorry to everyone who lost to this lol[/strike]
Gem showing the wrong teams color and shape
Gem always explodes
Gem sparkles no longer linger
Waiting screen reorganized so chat isn't covered
Chat being rendered in the background
Chat being broken if there were multiple local players
Pause menu detaching from player camera
Boardgame players fighting too hard for their spaces making it hard to pass (they still fight. its funny so its a feature not a bug)
Boardgame players have better pathfinding
Boardgame players no longer spawn inside of each other
Boardgame players have and easier time getting over certain stairs
Boardgame players teleport much quicker if the pathfinding breaks
Players will be properly sorted after gaining or losing money on the board


Thank You!
I want to just say a BIG thank you to everyone trying out Mini Bash! We worked very hard on it for a long time and its been amazing seeing the clips of everyone having such a good time. It means the world to us! 

If you have questions or feedback, join our Discord through the store page—we want Mini Bash to be a long-term project with new modes and ways to play! Come check out the roadmap!

An extra thank you to everyone who left a nice review, it means a lot! 

Coming soon...

Speaking of roadmap, here are some things we can share:

More supported languages (shoutout to everyone pushing through even if they can’t read the menus!).
A wave-based survival mode! Something that can be played and enjoyed in its entirety either offline single player or online with friends! The tutorial bot is just a small taste of this, but we love it and want to expand it into a third staple game mode!


On the topic of a roadmap, some things we are willing to share as some priorities are more supported languages (shoutout everyone pushing through even if they cant understand the menus) and a single player friendly wave based survival mode! The bot in the tutorial is a small taste of this but we love it and want to expand it into a 3rd staple game mode! 

See you ingame!
